# semaphore_ex_project_template_inventory (Data Source)

Attaches an additional inventory to a template. The template's inventory_id selects its default inventory. Destroy detaches this association and preserves the inventory itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_template_inventory" "extra" {
  project_id   = 1
  template_id  = 2
  inventory_id = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inventory_id` (Number) Inventory to attach. An inventory can belong to only one template. Value must be at least 1.
- `project_id` (Number) Project containing the template and inventory. Value must be at least 1.
- `template_id` (Number) Template receiving the inventory. Value must be at least 1.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Compound association identity.
